workload.useful_operation: transport-8-same-single: original request/response and checked service effect through existing grants; all offered attempts and real refusals retained.

measurement.clock: AArch64 architectural counter via production native CLOCK; declared QEMU TCG

sampling.stopping_rule: Fixed 576-boot campaign: twelve fresh alternating OFF/ON pairs per case/profile in preregistered pair-round order. No retry or replacement. Latency population is success-conditioned and actual losses/sample shortfalls remain visible and INELIGIBLE; throughput is one measured aggregate, zero separate aggregate warmup observations, retaining actual request warmups.

overhead.collection_method: Both modes retain three CLOCK probes and every fixed offered operation. ON adds exactly one volatile middle.ticks store; OFF omits only that store. Match all measured offered IDs/outcomes; differing outcome vectors are INCONCLUSIVE, no success truncation or exact subtraction.

metrics.definition: Descriptive nearest-rank MEDIAN of OFF successful userspace Submit-to-Collect envelopes; includes common probes and scheduling. All refusals retained separately. At most32 successes/boot do not establish tail precision.
metrics.denominator: one successful useful request, conditioned on actual terminal success

methodologies.section: 1.2 and 1.3: validation, disclosure and reproducibility principles
TOE/SPD/SFR/SAR conceptual model; no normative component mapping
Data quality and validation of measures

security.toe: Production native.request/1 capability, identity, lifetime and bounded charging mechanisms; external original ELF workload and host evidence admission.

spd.attacker_model: Untrusted requesters or malformed user frames/handles; malformed or incomplete external reports and retained evidence. Malicious kernel or fully forged evidence chain is excluded.
threats: Foreign or stale process/capability identity accepted; SEND rights widened or receiver authority substituted.
Quota or retained request lifetime violated during exhaustion/revoke.
Fake useful success, missing observations or stale evidence admitted as verified performance.
assumptions: Trusted immutable development boot image/grant inputs and working declared QEMU counter.
Original ELF/source custody is retained and reviewed, not cryptographic attestation; physical hardware and production image authentication are outside scope.
policies: No privilege, buffer or timeout changes for benchmark success.
Actual failures/refusals and mandatory missing/failed SAR remain visible and prevent qualifying admission.
boundaries: Selected CPU0->0 and CPU0->1 paths; two-requester cross-CPU cases, original16-byte counter separately.
No broad fuzz, physical, vulnerability-certification, exclusive CPU, PMU or production supervisor acceptance claim.

sfr.claim: IPC service tokens and request receipts are scoped to actual executing process identity; forged/foreign caller access is rejected.
SEND/receiver rights and attenuation follow actual production capability checks; client IDs or numeric names cannot mint authority.
Process-local identity and generation separate stale or foreign capabilities and prevent cross-domain aliasing.
Admission and terminal ownership preserve bounded quota charging and eventual acquired reclamation; exhaustion cannot create unaccounted ownership.
Revoke prevents subsequent admission through affected authority while preserving already accepted request/receipt lifetime until terminal collection.
Actual original service execution agrees with payload/sequence or counter final-state oracle; incomplete or fabricated evidence cannot satisfy the declared importer checks.

sar.scope: Independent source-bound review of actual native IPC/handles/domains/revoke paths, external actors and evidence pipeline; not an execution substitute.
Fresh full DEV/PROD matrix and named actual passing caller/rights/stale/domain/charge/revoke assertions, with verified same-invocation donor lineage and source matching.
Invalid inputs to actual production methods and host report/admission oracle; forged count/sequence/identity, incomplete custody and missing required evidence rejected without production mutation.
Fresh original kernel/application ELFs, useful reply/sequence/final counter state, complete outcomes and normal root retirement/reclamation.

security.ava_van_scope: Not evaluated; current bounded source/runtime/negative input evidence is not vulnerability certification.
security.attack_potential_scope: Not evaluated; no attack potential level claimed.
